subject: Staging account overusage — write-off and VAT routing
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@frostbyte.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T07:42:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected spike on staging — charges and VAT

Hi Diego,

We noticed a large unexpected usage spike on our staging project (staging-prod-01) between 2027-03-29 and 2027-04-02 that generated a charge of $23,400 on the April invoice. This looks like our CI environment began hitting the production model endpoint after a tagging change.

I've attached a slimmed usage file and the invoice excerpt for your review. Can Redwood make a one-time write-off for the staging-related usage? We are VAT-registered in Belgium and will need the credit to be issued net of VAT if possible.

Attachments: frostbyte_usage_apr2027.csv (CSV), invoice_20270401.pdf (PDF)

We'd prefer a credit memo applied to next invoice, but if a refund is easier for accounting we can take that as well — let me know the options and any evidence you need (we can attach our VAT reg certificate).

Thanks,
Liam
Billing Lead, Frostbyte AI
[Attachment: frostbyte_usage_apr2027.csv (CSV)]
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@frostbyte.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on staging — charges and VAT

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for the usage extract. I'm sorry about the disruption; that spike looks like a classic staging/prod tag bleed.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop finance and ops (cc'd Ben) to triage the charge and confirm what we can write off as goodwill/staging remediation.
- Please send VAT registration (EU) and the signed SLA for staging (you mentioned this in the onboarding notes) so we can determine VAT routing on the credit.
- Do you have a preferred resolution: credit memo applied to next invoice vs. direct refund? You said both are possible — if you prefer a refund, include the routing instructions (or say card on file).

I'll aim to get an initial position from finance by tomorrow EOD.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invoice_20270401.pdf (PDF) referenced]
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Unexpected spike on staging — charges and VAT

Diego / Marissa — taking this one.

Summary of facts:
- External invoice dated 2027-04-01 shows $23,400 charge tied to project staging-prod-01.
- Customer supplied usage extract (attached) showing 94% of those tokens were from jobs tagged as "staging" between 2027-03-29 and 2027-04-02.

Proposed remediation (one-time):
1) Goodwill write-off: remove the portion of usage attributable to non-production tagging. Based on our quick audit, that's $18,700 (net).
2) VAT treatment: Frostbyte is VAT-registered in BE. We will issue the credit memo for the net amount and adjust VAT on the associated invoices — customer must provide their VAT reg certificate (BE VAT ID) so we can record zero-rated reverse-charge where applicable.
3) Payment flow: preference is to issue a credit memo to be applied to next invoice. If customer insists on refund, finance will process refund to the original payment method; refunds may take 5–7 business days to appear.

Required items to proceed:
- Copy of BE VAT registration (VAT certificate)
- Signed SLA/staging agreement (to evidence approved sandbox testing policy)
- Confirmation from the customer whether they want a credit memo or a refund to the card on file

I'll prepare a draft credit memo (internal ref RDF-783) and circulate for signature once items above are received. CC'ing Marissa for legal sign-off on the VAT wording.

[Attachment: finance_audit_staging_extract.xlsx (XLSX) — internal]

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@frostbyte.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@frostbyte.ai
Date: 2027-04-05T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on staging — charges and VAT

Diego / Ben,

Thanks for the quick review and the proposed remediation. We can provide the BE VAT certificate and the signed SLA — attaching now.

We'd prefer a partial refund of the $18,700 (net) rather than a credit memo if possible; our treasury team has a reconciliation run next week and a refund makes the close smoother. If refund is a problem, apply the credit and we'll take it, but refund is preferred.

I've attached: vat_evidence_BE.pdf and signed_sla_staging.pdf.

Let me know any additional fields you need for the refund (bank wire details vs. card).

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Billing Lead, Frostbyte AI
[Attachment: vat_evidence_BE.pdf (PDF), signed_sla_staging.pdf (PDF)]
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@frostbyte.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on staging — write-off and VAT routing (Confirmed)

Hi Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround and the documents.

We will proceed with a refund as requested. Finance has prepared a credit memo for our records (Credit Memo RDF-783) and we'll process a refund for the $18,700 net amount. VAT handling: because Frostbyte provided a BE VAT registration, the credit will be net and the VAT will be reversed on our VAT filings — you will receive an updated invoice/credit packet showing the net refund and VAT adjustment.

Timing: refund to the card on file will be processed within 2 business days; funds typically appear within 3–7 business days depending on the bank. If you prefer a wire instead, reply with bank details and we'll route via our payments team (wires can add 1–2 days).

Deliverables and links:
- Credit memo (attached): credit_memo_RDF-783.pdf
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910
- Internal ticket for audit: SUP-2145

I'll mark this resolved after the refund completes. Thanks for working with us and apologies again for the staging tag leak — we'll follow up with a post-mortem and a recommendation for tag-guard rules to prevent recurrence.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_memo_RDF-783.pdf (PDF)]
